name: manual_9de5ba
claim: A Windows ACL fallback protecting TLS keys must refuse when the expected absolute System32 executable is absent or relative; never fall back to cwd or PATH lookup. Cross-platform dispatch tests must patch the import-time flags actually read by the function, and cannot establish real Windows ACL qualification.
